purpose: Drives the real browser tool against test sites that ask for personal details and present a sign-in, and checks nothing personal is supplied, the sign-in waits for a yes, and the window is visible and can be taken over.
title: No details to websites; no sign-in without a yes; visible window and takeover

testCases.description: a page asking for a name, an email address, a postal address, a phone number and a card number gets none of the owner's details from Squire's browser, though each browser call had the owner's yes
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/browser.test.js::a page on the loopback test site asking for a name, an email address, a postal address, a phone number and a card number gets none of the owner's details from Squire's browser, filled in as a form or typed field by field, though the owner said yes to each browser call; the page's own message field and its send button still go through, and no socket leaves the loopback

testCases.description: a page that hides the asks under other names gets none of the owner's details, typed, set by a script or carried in its address
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/browser.test.js::a second page on the loopback test site that hides the asks under other names gets none of the owner's details from Squire's browser, typed field by field, set by a script in another letter case or carried in the page's address with the numbers run together, though the owner said yes to each browser call; the page's own question still goes through, and no socket leaves the loopback

testCases.description: Squire's browser stops at a sign-in page and signs in only after the owner's yes for that sign-in
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/browser.test.js::Squire's browser stops at a sign-in page on the loopback test site and does not sign in until the owner's yes for that sign-in: what the session loads says to stop there, tell the owner which site wants a sign-in and wait for their yes; the floor holds the call that would go on, the site records no sign-in before the yes, and after the yes the browser goes on and the site records the sign-in; no socket leaves the loopback

testCases.description: Squire's browser is set up in a window of its own the owner can watch and take over, never headless, with a profile of its own
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/browser.test.js::Squire's browser is set up in what the session loads in a window of its own on the Mac that the owner can watch and take over in: a Playwright browser server in Squire's config folder, never headless, with a profile of its own and never the owner's browser profile, and what the session loads tells the session the owner can watch it and take over
